import "experimental"

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prediction" and r._field == "failure_probability")
  |> group(columns: ["engine_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: if r._time >= experimental.subDuration(d: 60s, from: now()) then 1.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group()
  |> sum()

staleAfter = 60

from(bucket: "telemetry")
    |> range(start: -24h)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        r._measurement == "prediction" and
        (
            r._field == "failure_probability" or
            r._field == "predicted_class" or
            r._field == "cycle"
        )
    )
    |> pivot(
        rowKey: ["_time"],
        columnKey: ["_field"],
        valueColumn: "_value"
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.failure_probability)
    |> group(columns: ["engine_id"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
    |> limit(n: 1)
    |> map(fn: (r) => {
        ageSeconds =
            (int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time))
                / 1000000000

        status =
            if ageSeconds > staleAfter then
                "STALE DATA"
            else if exists r.predicted_class then
                if int(v: r.predicted_class) == 1 then
                    "ALERT"
                else
                    "NO ALERT"
            else
                "LABEL UNAVAILABLE"

        return {
            "Engine": r.engine_id,
            "Score": float(v: r.failure_probability),
            "Status": status,

            "Cycle":
                if exists r.cycle then
                    string(v: int(v: r.cycle))
                else
                    "—",

            "Maintenance": "Not available",

            "Last Update":
                if ageSeconds < 0 then
                    "Clock mismatch"
                else
                    string(v: ageSeconds) + "s ago"
        }
    })
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["Score"], desc: true)
    |> yield(name: "engine_monitoring")

from(bucket: "telemetry")
    |> range(
        start: v.timeRangeStart,
        stop: v.timeRangeStop
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        r._measurement == "prediction" and
        r._field == "predicted_class"
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.engine_id)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,
        engine_id: r.engine_id,
        _value:
            if int(v: r._value) == 1 then
                "Alert"
            else
                "No Alert"
    }))
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["engine_id", "_time"])
    |> yield(name: "alert_state_history")

staleSeconds = 60
staleNs = staleSeconds * 1000000000

reportTime =
    if v.timeRangeStop < now() then
        v.timeRangeStop
    else
        now()

isLive = int(v: now()) - int(v: reportTime) <= staleNs

// Read and combine prediction fields
data =
    from(bucket: "telemetry")
        |> range(
            start: v.timeRangeStart,
            stop: v.timeRangeStop
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "prediction" and
            (
                r._field == "predicted_class" or
                r._field == "failure_probability" or
                r._field == "cycle"
            )
        )
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            r with _value: float(v: r._value)
        }))
        |> group(columns: ["engine_id"])
        |> pivot(
            rowKey: ["_time"],
            columnKey: ["_field"],
            valueColumn: "_value"
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            exists r.predicted_class and
            exists r.failure_probability and
            exists r.cycle
        )
        |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            engine_id: r.engine_id,
            _time: r._time,
            alarm: int(v: r.predicted_class),
            risk: float(v: r.failure_probability),
            time_delta: int(v: r._time),
            cycle_delta: int(v: r.cycle)
        }))

        // Detect data gaps and simulation resets
        |> difference(
            columns: ["time_delta", "cycle_delta"],
            keepFirst: true
        )
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            r with
            segment:
                if not exists r.time_delta then 1
                else if r.time_delta > staleNs then 1
                else if exists r.cycle_delta and
                    r.cycle_delta < 0 then 1
                else 0
        }))
        |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["segment"])

// Identify the latest segment for each engine
latest =
    data
        |> group(columns: ["engine_id"])
        |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
        |> last(column: "segment")
        |> keep(columns: ["engine_id", "segment", "_time"])
        |> rename(columns: {
            segment: "latest_segment",
            _time: "latest_time"
        })

// Identify and summarize alert episodes
episodes =
    data
        |> group(columns: ["engine_id", "segment"])
        |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with row_number: 1}))
        |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["row_number"])
        |> stateTracking(
            fn: (r) => r.alarm == 1,
            countColumn: "alert_streak"
        )
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            r with
            episode: if r.alert_streak == 1 then 1 else 0
        }))
        |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["episode"])
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r.episode > 0)
        |> group(columns: ["engine_id", "segment", "episode"])
        |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
        |> reduce(
            identity: {
                start_ns: 0,
                end_ns: 0,
                last_ns: 0,
                peak: 0.0,
                partial: false
            },
            fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
                start_ns:
                    if accumulator.start_ns == 0 then
                        int(v: r._time)
                    else
                        accumulator.start_ns,

                end_ns:
                    if r.alarm == 0 and
                        accumulator.end_ns == 0 then
                        int(v: r._time)
                    else
                        accumulator.end_ns,

                last_ns: int(v: r._time),

                peak:
                    if r.alarm == 1 and
                        r.risk > accumulator.peak then
                        r.risk
                    else
                        accumulator.peak,

                partial:
                    if accumulator.start_ns == 0 then
                        r.row_number == 1
                    else
                        accumulator.partial
            })
        )
        |> group(columns: ["engine_id"])

// Build the final table
join(
    tables: {episodes: episodes, latest: latest},
    on: ["engine_id"],
    method: "inner"
)
    |> group()
    |> map(fn: (r) => {
        ended = r.end_ns > 0

        fresh =
            int(v: reportTime) - int(v: r.latest_time)
                <= staleNs

        status =
            if ended then "Ended"
            else if r.segment != r.latest_segment then
                "Interrupted"
            else if not fresh then "Data Stale"
            else if isLive then "Active"
            else "Open at range end"

        durationEnd =
            if ended then r.end_ns else r.last_ns

        return {
            Engine: r.engine_id,
            "Start Time": string(v: time(v: r.start_ns)),
            "End Time":
                if ended then
                    string(v: time(v: r.end_ns))
                else
                    "--",
            "Duration (s)":
                float(v: durationEnd - r.start_ns)
                    / 1000000000.0,
            "Peak Risk": r.peak,
            Status:
                if r.partial then
                    status + " (partial start)"
                else
                    status
        }
    })
    |> sort(columns: ["Start Time"], desc: true)
    |> yield(name: "alert_episodes")

import "experimental"

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prediction" and r._field == "failure_probability")
  |> group(columns: ["engine_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: if r._time >= experimental.subDuration(d: 60s, from: now()) and r._value >= 0.620000 then 1.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group()
  |> sum()

import "experimental"

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prediction" and r._field == "failure_probability")
  |> group(columns: ["engine_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: if r._time >= experimental.subDuration(d: 60s, from: now()) then 0.0 else 1.0}))
  |> group()
  |> sum()

import "experimental"

fresh = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prediction" and r._field == "failure_probability")
  |> group(columns: ["engine_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= experimental.subDuration(d: 60s, from: now()))

fresh
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value >= 0.620000 then 1.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group()
  |> reduce(
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      count: accumulator.count + 1.0,
      above: accumulator.above + r._value,
    }),
    identity: {count: 0.0, above: 0.0},
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: now(),
    _value: if r.count == 0.0 then 0.0 else (r.above / r.count) * 100.0,
  }))
